verdict.rationale: incident.io has an Insights area that supports custom relative time ranges (Week/Month/Quarter) and a previous-period comparison toggle, which enables trend tracking. Post-mortem completion can be tracked org-wide, and the MCP server advertises 'deep operational analysis'. The evidence never names the specific metrics this story asks for. Missing for 10: explicit MTTA/MTTR metrics, incident load/volume dashboards, on-call health or burden analytics, independent or hands-on corroboration of the Insights reporting.
